dedupe_keys.name: masnum wam wave climate model and processing code

description: The MASNUM-WAM research team deposits the wave model and processing code used to generate its global wave-climate collection. ScienceDB identifies the wave solver as Fortran and the post-processing program as MATLAB. The latter separates monthly output containing 17 wave and two wind parameters into smaller files for individual variables. The deposit contains 73 files, about 10.67 MB, with free access under CC BY 4.0. Its documented application covers historical conditions in 1950–2014 and future experiments through 2100 using FIO-ESM wind forcing. It can generate marine resource or hazard inputs for infrastructure simulations, alongside energy-planning tools such as model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that reproducing these experiments also requires forcing, configuration and compatible compilers. The own description contains an unresolved SSP125/SSP126 naming discrepancy relative to the article. No source archive was downloaded or model run.
